description: Defines the FoodItem class used for representing food data, including name and calories per 100 grams, with methods for mapping from and to JSON-like structures.

classes.name: FoodItem
classes.description: Represents a food item with name and caloric content per 100 grams, capable of serialization from and to a map.

methods.name: FoodItem.fromMap
methods.description: Factory constructor that creates a FoodItem instance from a map, extracting 'name' and 'calories_per_100g'.

methods.name: FoodItem.toMap
methods.description: Converts the FoodItem instance into a map suitable for JSON serialization, with keys 'name' and 'calories_per_100g'.
